jobs.title: Product Manager Collaborations, Partnerships & Energy
jobs.location: EMEA > BEL > Antwerp  > VF Europe Link 1
jobs.description:
Eastpak Global is looking for an exceptional Product Manager Collaborations, Partnerships & Energy to join our Product team based in Antwerp, Belgium .

At Eastpak , we’re Built to Resist whatever life throws at us, as we express ourselves as individuals and inspire positive resistance. Since we started our journey half a century ago, we’ve refined our classic bag designs and continue to innovate and collaborate with some of the world’s leading creatives.

Eastpak is Built to Resist , are you?

Let’s talk about the role!
You will help keep Eastpak relevant and future-focused by bringing culture into the product portfolio. You will lead strategic collaborations from concept to market while creating opportunities to translate cultural inspiration into future collections, franchises, and product initiatives. By balancing flawless execution with a test-and-learn mindset, you will help build brand energy today while inspiring the mainline portfolio of tomorrow.

How You Will Make a Difference

Collaboration Management
- Lead the end-to-end execution of all collaboration projects, from concept through market launch.

- Identify and recommend commercial collaboration opportunities that drive business growth and brand relevance.

- Partner closely with Marketing, who leads the selection, launch strategy and calendar of elevated collaborations, by assessing feasibility and leading their execution from concept to market.

- Act as the central project lead across partners, creative collectives, design, development, merchandising, planning, marketing, legal, finance, sales, operations, and go-to-market teams.

- Develop product briefs together with partners, design, and development teams, balancing partner vision, consumer relevance, and commercial objectives.

- Own project planning and execution, including contracts, territories, timelines, development briefings, budgets, launch readiness, and milestone management.

- Coordinate commercial deliverables, including business planning, account lists, price lists, buy timing, sales tools, royalty reporting, and sell-off tracking.

- Partner with Merchandising, who owns assortment planning, commercial assortment selection, segmentation, distribution planning, and commercial terms, while ensuring seamless execution of every collaboration.

- Monitor collaboration performance and recommend future partnership opportunities.

Culture Innovation
- Lead culture-driven product initiatives that strengthen the Eastpak brand beyond traditional collaborations.

- Build and manage relationships with cultural partners, creators, and VF design collectives to continuously bring fresh inspiration into the brand.

- Translate collaboration learnings, cultural insights, and emerging trends into opportunities for future collections, franchises, apparel initiatives, and product concepts.

- Create and lead test-and-learn pilots that explore new ideas and identify concepts with potential to scale into the mainline portfolio.

- Share external inspiration and cultural insights with product, design, and merchandising teams to influence future product direction and keep the portfolio culturally relevant.

Skills for Success
- 7+ years of experience in merchandising, product management, collaborations, partnerships, product innovation, or related fields.

- Proven experience leading complex cross-functional projects from concept to market launch.

- Strong understanding of consumer trends, cultural movements, and lifestyle brands.

- Strong project management and stakeholder leadership skills.

- Strong understanding of product creation, merchandising, and go-to-market processes.

- Experience managing fashion, lifestyle, or brand collaborations.

- Ability to translate cultural insights and partnerships into product opportunities.

- Strong balance of creative thinking and operational execution.

- Excellent communication, influencing, and relationship-building skills.

- Comfortable working across multiple functions and external partners.

- Able to operate in both strategic and hands-on environments.

A formal education and subsequent University Bachelor or Master’s degree in Business, Marketing, Fashion Management, Product Management, Design, Innovation are nice to have, but we are most interested in your total experience and professional achievements.

What’s in it For You
We’re in the business of unleashing human potential, driven by the ideas, energy and commitment of our people. That’s why we offer comprehensive benefits that encourage mental, physical and financial well-being for all VF associates. When it comes to benefits, we’re the total package.
- A supportive feedback-based culture where respect and integrity guide us in what we do

- An inclusive international environment where people of diverse backgrounds, lifestyles and nationalities love working together

- Be part of an iconic lifestyle brand in a multi brand, multi countries organization

- On site gym offering health and well-being initiatives

- A discount card with 50% on all VF brands

This post is not eligible for relocation support

VF is a global apparel company connecting people to the lifestyles they cherish through our family of iconic brands. At the heart of our journey lies our purpose: We power movements of sustainable and active lifestyles for the betterment of people and our planet. This is our purpose. It’s the reason we come to work every day. Our purpose unites us and leads us to pursue our goals, together. This is our calling. Learn more at vfc.com

Free to Be, Inclusion & Diversity
As an equal opportunity employer, we strive to foster a culture of belonging based on respect, connection, openness and authenticity. We are committed to building and maintaining a workplace that celebrates the diversity of our associates, allowing them to bring their authentic selves to work every day.
If you like what you have read and want to join our team then we would like to hear from you! Apply, visit vfc.com , Eastpak.com or follow us on our LinkedIn and Instagram pages, see you there!

jobs.title: Sr. Product Manager (Finance)
jobs.description:
SAP Finance Principal Product Owner

About the Role:
VF Corporation is seeking an exceptional SAP Finance Principal Product Owner to join our SAP ERP team in Shanghai, China. This role is pivotal to our SAP S/4 Transformation program in the APAC region, which aims to enhance flexibility, improve customer services, and reduce complexity by implementing industry best practices and adopting the SAP clean core strategy.

Key Responsibilities:
- Lead Implementation:  Oversee the implementation of the new S/4 solution, managing resources (both internal and external), timelines, and budgets within the finance area.
- Adopt Best Practices:  Promote the adoption of industry best practices by leveraging S/4 standard capabilities.
- Cross-Functional Collaboration:  Facilitate collaboration across teams, manage and reconcile multiple stakeholder views, resolve conflicts, and address diverse audience perspectives.
- Team Development:  Develop and mentor a team of professional managers and experienced individual contributors within your domain.

Specific Duties:
- Business Process Translation:  Translate business processes and requirements into system functionality.

- Collaboration:  Foster collaboration and trust to influence cross-functional teams, ensuring strategies are executed through reliable processes.

- SAP Finance Expertise:  Maintain deep knowledge of SAP Finance capabilities, including General Ledger, Controlling, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Fixed Assets, and integration with Order to Cash, Retail, E-commerce, Logistics, and Procurement.

- Financial Process SME:  Serve as the Subject Matter Expert on financial processes, ensuring all financial requirements are met.

- Documentation:  Collaborate with business and team members to identify and document business processes, functional specifications, test plans/scripts, and deployment plans.

- Solution Design:  Design future finance solutions, enhancements, and continuous improvements for SAP based on business priorities and initiatives.

- Security Role Definitions:  Define security roles for users in the SAP Finance space and participate in the segregation of duties.

- Internal Processes Oversight:  Provide input and oversight on internal processes related to SAP master data, hierarchies, and reporting.

- Support Transition:  Coordinate with application support to ensure a seamless transition from Hypercare activities.

- Audit Controls:  Manage and satisfy SAP audit controls and pertinent SOX program requirements.

- Financial Close Support:  Support monthly financial close, forecasting processes, budgeting, and planning.

- Hands-on Experience:  Hands-on experience with SAP S4 HANA or SAP FICO is preferred.

Qualifications:
- Education:  Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Information Systems, or a related area preferred, or equivalent work experience.
- Experience:  10+ years of experience with SAP modules, including FI-GL, AR, AP, Credit and Asset Management, Special Ledger FI-SL, Project Systems, Bank Accounting, Foreign Currency, and/or Treasury. Experience in the implementation of SAP for a multinational group in the APAC region is required.
- Skills:  Ability to work quickly and accurately under pressure and time constraints. Demonstrated critical thinking and analytical skills are required; ability to apply systems knowledge to troubleshoot and analyze new issues is critical.
- Leadership:  Experience in leading financial operations for Product & Technology groups preferred.
- Self-Starter:  Must be a self-starter, able to work independently with a proactive working style.
- Communication:  Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
- Language:  professional English (written and spoken) is a must

Special Requirements:
Travel:  Travel by air and overnight, as required (20% of the time)

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager, Central Finance
jobs.location: USCA > USA > North Carolina > Greensboro - VFC
jobs.description:
At VF, we strive to foster a culture of belonging based on respect, connection, openness, and authenticity.  So, before we get to the job details, take a minute to learn a little more about us – our values and our culture - visit  VF Careers  or  www.vfc.com .

What will you do?
A day in the life of a Principal Product Manager, Central Finance at VF looks a little like this.

The Principal Product Manager, Central Finance  is responsible for the product strategy, roadmap, and delivery of VF's SAP Central Finance platform. This role serves as the primary liaison between Global Finance, Accounting, Shared Services, and Technology teams to drive the implementation of a unified finance execution layer that standardizes global processes across AP, AR, General Ledger, Intercompany, Fixed Assets, Treasury, Cash Management, and Financial Close.

Let’s break down that day-in-the-life a bit more.
Product Strategy & Roadmap
- Own the Central Finance product vision, roadmap, and deployment strategy aligned to VF's global finance transformation program.
- Prioritize business capabilities that support process harmonization and finance back-office centralization.
- Develop and maintain product backlogs, release plans, and business value realization metrics.

Business Partnership
- Partner with Corporate Finance, Controllers, Shared Services, Treasury, Tax, and accounting leaders to support the design and implementation of future-state business processes.
- Translate business requirements into scalable SAP Central Finance solutions.
- Partner with Finance Data teams to define and implement master data requirements supporting global finance harmonization

Product Delivery
- Lead implementation of Central Finance capabilities including: - General Ledger
- Intercompany Accounting
- Accounts Receivable
- Credit Management
- Vendor Payments
- Fixed Assets
- Treasury and Cash Management
- Advanced Financial Close

- Coordinate system integrations with operational ERPs and supporting finance applications.
- Oversee testing, cutover planning, deployment, and adoption activities.

Data & Governance
- Drive master data governance requirements supporting global finance harmonization.
- Partner with Finance Data and Analytics teams to establish common financial data standards.
- Ensure SOX-compliant controls are embedded into solution design.

Leadership
- Lead cross-functional teams consisting of business stakeholders, system integrators, architects, and delivery managers.
- Lead cross-functional product teams without direct organizational authority

What do you need to succeed?
We all have unique skills that we bring to work and celebrate every day. For this role, there are foundation skills you’ll need to succeed and excel. Additionally, while formal education in a related field is great to have, we are most interested in your 8 years of experience and professional achievements.

The foundation skills you will need in this position are:
- 8+ years of experience in Finance Technology, ERP Product Management, or SAP Finance transformations.
- Deep expertise in SAP S/4HANA Finance and Central Finance.
- Strong understanding of Record-to-Report, Close, Treasury, AP, AR, and Intercompany processes.
- Experience delivering SAP Finance capabilities as part of enterprise transformation initiatives.
- Proven ability to influence senior business stakeholders and drive adoption of standardized finance processes and technology solutions.

Now WE have a question for YOU.

jobs.title: Data Product Owner, Planning, Quality & Logistics
jobs.location: ASIA > SGP > Singapore > GMT Product Supply Office
jobs.description:
Join The VF Digital Technology Family!
We are looking for a talented Data Product Owner with a Supply Chain background, strong analytical thinking, and hands-on Agile experience to support the delivery of Data and AI-powered Supply Chain Data Products across the Planning, Logistics and Quality domains. This role sits within our Digital Technology (DT) organisation and partners closely with Global Supply Chain business users and the DT Product Owners to bring data-driven, insight-rich products to life.
How You Will Make a Difference
What you will do:
Support End-to-End Product Ownership
- Contribute to the full lifecycle of Data and AI data product(s) in your scope across Planning, Logistics and Quality: shaping requirements, supporting design, coordinating development, testing, release and continuous improvement.
- Maintain and refine the product backlog in alignment with the Supply Chain Data Product roadmap owned by the Senior Data Product Owner.

Product Roadmap and Strategy
- Translate business needs and user feedback into clear use cases, supporting the Senior Data Product Owner in shaping the product vision and roadmap.
- Assist in developing product concepts, value assessments and prioritisation proposals.

Product Design
- Partner with business users and technical teams to co-design solutions that offer a good end-to-end user experience across interfaces, dashboards and AI-driven features.
- Help document business rules, data definitions and acceptance criteria.

Product Development
- Collaborate within an Agile team framework and actively participate in sprint ceremonies.
- Work closely with Product Owners, Analysts, Data Engineers and Architects to ensure alignment on features, dependencies and delivery timelines.

Benefits Realisation and Product Performance
- Support the monitoring of product KPIs and release-specific success metrics.
- Work with business COE teams to support user adoption and a smooth experience of delivered features.

Data Governance and Quality
- Ensure requirements and features align with VF's data governance policies, business definition standards and AI ethics standards.
- Assist in monitoring data integrity and raise issues proactively for remediation.

Product Management and Partnership
- Communicate progress, risks, dependencies and value outcomes to relevant stakeholders.
- Support planning of product releases and help coordinate expectations for upcoming features.
- Collaborate with external partners and vendors to support delivery quality and performance.

How you will do it:
- Engage with Planning, Logistics and Quality business users to gather product needs and translate them into clear user stories and acceptance criteria.
- Connect roadmap priorities to incremental product development and ensure transparency in backlog prioritisation.
- Help define metrics that measure value from data and AI-driven capabilities once released.
- Serve as a bridge between technical teams (engineering, data science, architecture, testing) and business teams.
- Validate product/feature outcomes by grounding decisions in user needs, business impact and data insights.
- Foster an organised, collaborative and Agile delivery rhythm within the team.

What success looks like:
- You gain a solid understanding of your product domain(s), users and the digital opportunities within Global Supply Chain, contributing meaningfully to the Data Product roadmap.
- You help ship reliable, trusted and well-adopted Data and AI products that strengthen VF's Data & Analytics transformation.
- Stakeholders view you as a dependable partner who brings clarity, structure and thoughtful recommendations.
- You build strong working relationships with business stakeholders, global digital teams and delivery partners.
- Product delivery becomes more efficient through well-groomed backlogs, clear documentation and smoother sprint execution.

Free to Be, Inclusion & Diversity
As a purpose-led, performance driven company, we strive to foster a culture of belonging based on respect, connection, openness, and authenticity. We are committed to building and maintaining a workplace that celebrates the diversity of our associates, allowing them to bring their authentic selves to work every day.
What we expect you already have:
- Years of related professional experience: Minimum 5 years.

- Educational position requirements: A formal education and subsequent undergraduate/graduate degrees in a related field are nice to have, but we are most interested in your total experience and professional achievements.
- Some exposure to owning or supporting Data and/or AI data products, from inception through adoption, is a plus.
- Skilled in leveraging AI tools for product management and day-to-day productivity enhancement.
- Experienced, or interested, in using AI to redesign/optimise workflows and achieve measurable outcomes.
- Business acumen developed within a Supply Chain domain — knowledge of planning, quality, or logistics is highly valued.
- Excellent communication skills, able to collaborate effectively across several stakeholder groups.
- Practical experience in product management, Scrum and Agile delivery.
- Familiarity with data and analytics tools such as Azure, Databricks, AWS, Tableau, PowerBI or KNIME; exposure to AI/ML product delivery is a plus.
- Front-end UX/UI awareness is a plus.
- Confidence to raise concerns, challenge ambiguity and make balanced recommendations.
- Integrity and courageousness — willing to say "No" when needed to protect product value and company interest.
- Empathy and inclusiveness, with the ability to navigate multi-stakeholder environments.
- An end-to-end mindset with great attention to detail.

What we will teach you:
- Leading agile product management and the data product development lifecycle in VF's digital environment.
- Deep knowledge of VF's digital platforms and data ecosystems across the region and the globe.
- Frameworks for defining product value, measuring impact and driving user adoption.
- VF's data governance standards, AI ethics frameworks and scalable data product practices.
- Collaboration within a global matrixed organisation and with engineering, analytics and vendor teams.
- Skills to grow into owning larger product scopes over time.

VF Guiding Principles
Live with Integrity, Act Courageously, Be Curious, Act with Empathy, and Persevere.

That's why we offer comprehensive benefits that encourage mental, physical and financial well-being for all VF associates. When it comes to benefits, we're the total package.
